method: Read existing writer bodies and nested components; supplement the lexical census with chained instance-call extraction, a conservative Core getter-name candidate census, direct Snapshot field references, and manual high-risk getter/planning source traces. The aid script was evaluated only before its file-write statement, in memory. No codec or C# execution occurred.
conclusions: The proposed single private writer extraction is source-feasible. No additional RNG draw, retained-dice reconstruction, authoritative resolver, command replay, deadline advancement or state mutation was found in the inspected writer-side call paths after the known Validation.Snapshot entry.

This is not a compiler-resolved full call-graph proof. Lexical overload merging, local functions, property receiver/type resolution and selected-wire conditional coverage remain explicit instrumentation/compiler-review obligations.

Preserve the exact existing public Encode validation, writer guards, optional branches, marker order, rational representation, component checksums, limit and final checksum. Do not replace the writer with object equality, JSON, fresh projection, canonical repair or a public unchecked encoder.

Canonical byte equality covers the selected save representation of an already validated owned snapshot. It is not equality or validation of every possible in-memory Snapshot. Validation-enforced omitted fields and derived/reconstructed metadata must remain inside the trusted owning-current-state boundary.

findings.fact: Public Encode first calls Validation.Snapshot. The body after that writes into new local buffers and appends checksum. Extract that exact body, including payload limit based on WireSchemaVersion; public Encode still validates first.
findings.obligation: Instrument the extracted comparison to prove Validation.Snapshot and retained-dice/history validators are not reached, while ordinary public Encode/Decode/strict restore continue to reject all malformed causal histories.

findings.fact: WorkLedger Encode checks null/version and legacy representability, then enumerates constructor-owned read-only arrays. RequiresRationalSchema uses Any and immutable amount/settlement facts; legacy Quantity can throw on fractional values, and Status uses rational comparisons. No Reserve/Consume/Release/Cancel or ledger validation is called by writing.
findings.obligation: Keep v1 legacy representability, fractional exception and v2 exact consumed/released amounts unchanged; do not route through AvailableAmount or reconstruct a new WorkLedger for comparison.

findings.fact: Journal Encode writes immutable operations and application/immunity data. It checks selected component version, relationship payload support, named-immunity bound, operation kind and byte limit. Operations is constructor-owned Array.AsReadOnly. It does not call View, a condition interpreter, Append, Advance or history replay. StructuralKey and Now are not needed by this writer.
findings.obligation: Do not introduce journal interpretation/normalization into the shared writer. Preserve exact operation order, optional values, version and structural errors.

findings.fact: WireSchemaVersion is not an auto-property: it selects from optional profile state and calls ConnectedExplorationObservation.IsSelected, then the existing chained fingerprint selectors. Inspected branches are string/presence classification, not replay or mutation. The selectors eventually include descendant profile prefixes.
findings.obligation: Pin this transitive chain and exercise old and descendant envelopes. Do not replace it with SchemaVersion or bypass the same nested-root validation performed on authoritative state.

findings.fact: RadianceUseRecord.PreRadianceHp() is the meaningful direct record-instance method omitted by an uppercase-receiver-only census; its body returns private backing field hpBefore.
findings.obligation: Retain the actual pre-Radiance field and conditional Consecration write; no projection or current HP reconstruction.

findings.fact: SpellCastRecord.ProcedureSha256 calls SpellSourceCatalog.Get. That performs a read-only SingleOrDefault over a static read-only catalog, with Bishop's static DispelSource fallback. Catalog initialization constructs immutable source definitions; this is distinct from retained gameplay validation/replay and uses no game RNG.
findings.obligation: Include catalog initialization/access in transitive instrumentation and pin source definitions. Do not flatten source-derived hashes or silently change behavior for invalid SpellId; actual current input is already validated.

findings.fact: Additional getter candidates consist of constants/aliases, invariant identity formatting, enum/status predicates, checked arithmetic and time/quantity comparisons, cloned string/value arrays, LINQ over immutable record collections, and derived exact rational values. RuleTime/RuleQuantity default denominator behavior is existing representation behavior, not a new comparison normalization. Progress Sum/Subtract creates values only. Collection clones allocate but do not mutate source state.
findings.obligation: Preserve arithmetic overflow/invalid-value behavior and exact ordering. The conservative getter table is a name-matched superset, not proof each candidate is reached by a given writer or wire.

findings.fact: Planning AvailableHands consults Snapshot.Creatures, but pre-Ferry selected wires omit Creatures. Validation explicitly requires the array empty when Ferry is absent. An artificially altered pre-Ferry Snapshot with extra Creatures could compare equal under an unchecked writer despite affecting hand availability.
findings.obligation: Only Simulation's freshly captured already validated current state may enter the owning checkpoint assessment. Do not accept caller snapshots or describe comparison as a general validator. Prove public/owning routes cannot inject such an omitted field; preserve public validation. No new save field or wire is proposed.

findings.fact: FixedEncounter WriteRecord writes ID/origin/initial order/start revisions/observed ordinals, not its RosterPhase or InheritedPhase references. The latter are bound during Decode from separately saved reinforcement/reengagement records and validated against them.
findings.obligation: Canonical comparison relies on validated consistency of these redundant references. Do not construct, repair or bind phases while reading; demonstrate capture does not expose mutable aliases that bypass the authoritative transition boundary.

findings.fact: Plan codec stores actual labor, status, terms, causal revisions/times and optional report. Its Work is reconstructed solely from fixed required duration plus labor in the immutable record constructor; Remaining/Retained are not separately saved. No arbitrary caller phase schedule exists on this record.
findings.obligation: Keep the fixed constructor-derived phases and accepted native remaining-work semantics; do not compare an invented duplicate progress representation.

findings.fact: PlanningPassage stores private owner-bound verified prefix evidence absent from Snapshot. Native replay currently supplies first-planning evidence when no passage is supplied. Exact canonical snapshot bytes alone cannot reproduce/authenticate this missing history witness.
findings.obligation: The actual owning checkpoint must supply existing immutable passage after identity/revision/policy/terms/current-bytes checks. Missing capability must fail safely without fallback; no read may build or advance the proof. Keep cutoff on completion revision, not just crossing start or current position.

findings.fact: Planning assessment consumes current condition permissions/life/hands, spatial and encounter facts, work occupancy, inventory/vessel/portable custody and amount, pressure/strain/rest debt and immutable selected policy terms. It is not satisfied solely by auditing the codec writer. Read-only condition projection is distinct from the writer and must be included in the complete assessment call graph.
findings.obligation: Instrument the full owning assessment/discovery/description route as well as the comparison. No hidden policy Resolve/Initial/ReplayReceipt, inventory settlement, future simulation or passage repair is permitted.

planningInputCoverage.inputs: ContentFingerprint, TestOnly, revision, clocks, current actor positions and receipts
planningInputCoverage.limit: Selected base schema versus derived wire semantics and owner/policy identity must all be checked; serialized receipts are not permission to replay during reads.

planningInputCoverage.inputs: ExpeditionEpisodeClose, NextCharterPlans terms/progress/report and immutable policy terms
planningInputCoverage.limit: Policy fields MandateAuthorized/EvidenceAccessible/DeskPermitted/WritingFacilitiesAvailable/ApproachAccess are selected policy configuration bound by actual policy identity/fingerprint, not new snapshot fields.

planningInputCoverage.inputs: Structures and station restrictions, current life/conditions, weapons/portable hands, shield/character state
planningInputCoverage.encoding: CraftingConsequenceCodec, ActorLifeCodec, ConditionJournalCodec, ClubAttackCodec, RangedCombatCodec, CharacterAdvancementCodec and PortableEquipmentCodec
planningInputCoverage.limit: Creature-derived hand denial has the explicit pre-Ferry omission in CT-08. Current condition projections must not be replaced with cached guesses.

planningInputCoverage.inputs: InventoryCombat, encounter/pending actions and calendar facts
planningInputCoverage.encoding: InventoryRecordCodec.cs:26; FixedEncounterCodec; TacticalMovement/ClubAttack/ReadyAction/Overwatch and later optional spell/Ferry codecs
planningInputCoverage.limit: Selected-profile validation enforces absent feature arrays empty; roster bindings are reconstructed metadata as in CT-09.

planningInputCoverage.inputs: World traversals/intervals/off-calendar activity, exclusive future bookings and plan work
planningInputCoverage.limit: Whole future interval occupancy is current data, not permission to advance deadlines; passage proof is separate private checkpoint state.

planningInputCoverage.inputs: Walkability, occupancy, reserved route path and later encounter admission
planningInputCoverage.encoding: ObservationCodec, route travel/spatial codecs, actor positions, inventory/encounter and later encounter records
planningInputCoverage.limit: Authored terrain and selected encounter/route policy are immutable policy configuration, not all independently serialized snapshot data.

planningInputCoverage.inputs: Ration/water families, exact quantities/available claims, owner/custody/access/freshness/carrying
planningInputCoverage.encoding: InventoryRecordCodec, WorkLedgerCodec, WaterVesselCodec, PortableEquipmentCodec and selected crop/preservation histories
planningInputCoverage.limit: AvailableAmount and family/freshness projections are pure native read computations outside writer; keep source-specific gates and exact rational values.

planningInputCoverage.inputs: Pressure, Expedition Strain, recovery gates/removals and rest debt
planningInputCoverage.limit: Do not substitute Warrior Strain, infer unsupported empty profile applicability, or settle pending recovery while reading.

instrumentationObligations: Observe actual owning Simulation read entry across assess, discover, describe, cost and choice paths; instrument both comparison and downstream pure native assessment.

Count forbidden Validation.Snapshot and causal validator entry, DiceStream construction/draw/RandomV1 advancement, Initial, ReplayReceipt, ReconstructCanonicalHistory, Resolve/ResolveCore, deadline settlement and choice resolution; unchanged final RandomState is insufficient.

Track checkpoint object/passage/canonical buffer and complete current state before/after every read, including failed capability and duplicate-receipt reads; no proof repair, lazy passage creation or live mutation.

Compare extracted writer bytes against original validated encoder on genuine selected-wire corpus, old profiles, rational ledger v1/v2, journal v1/v2, pending states and all nested optional histories. Preserve raw exceptions/limits and byte equality.
Verify ownership isolation with byte-identical separate Simulations; stale revision/policy/terms/profile/checkpoint and exposed-copy mutation must not transfer proof.

Explicitly test trusted input boundary for omitted invalid fields such as pre-Ferry Creatures and inconsistent redundant roster metadata through actual public/owning routes. Such invalid data must still fail strict Encode/restore; do not claim the unchecked internal comparator alone validates it.
Verify successful execution/restore replaces or obtains the checkpoint only through existing validated routes; rejection, queries and observations leave it untouched.

Keep the internal comparison and friend declaration under the exact TEST_ONLY assembly condition, inspect every call site and ensure no public save/DTO/console path returns unchecked bytes or accepts caller-provided predecessor buffers.
Resolve candidate getter/overload entries against actual compiled symbols during later implementation review. Static 284-name/85-file and 249-field-name counts are coverage aids only.
residualUncertainty: No pure writer or new Core assessment protocol exists yet; exact access arrangement, exception mapping and public DTO design are still proposed.
The conservative getter census uses member-name matching and intentionally includes false positives. It is not per-wire symbol resolution or a verified complete graph.
BCL serialization, hashing, UTF8 and immutable collection enumeration were treated as serialization infrastructure; no runtime instrumentation or performance measurement was performed.
No new planning gameplay witness or source-policy acceptance is asserted. The inspected source supports the design with the trusted-state limitation above.

conservativeGetterCandidates.body:
=> Events.LastOrDefault(x => x.Kind == CharterAttemptEventKind.Suspended
            || x.Kind == CharterAttemptEventKind.Continued)?.Kind == CharterAttemptEventKind.Suspended;

=> Returned != null
            ? Stop == null && Observed != null ? CharterAttemptOutcome.ReturnedComplete : CharterAttemptOutcome.ReturnedIncomplete
            : Stop == null ? CharterAttemptOutcome.Open : OutboundStarted == null
                ? CharterAttemptOutcome.EndedAtStaging : CharterAttemptOutcome.AwaitingLawfulReturn;

=> string.Join("|", ObjectiveId, MilestoneId, ActorId, SourceRevision, "0",
            FirstEncounterId, LaterEncounterId, SpecimenId, RecipeId, "actual-normal-closure|consumed-settled-batch|alive-not-positive-hp");

=> Status == ExpeditionBillStatus.Working || Status == ExpeditionBillStatus.Paused
            || Status == ExpeditionBillStatus.PendingCompletion;

=> Status == HavenSaleStatus.Working || Status == HavenSaleStatus.Paused
            || Status == HavenSaleStatus.PendingSettlement;

=> Status == NextCharterPlanStatus.Working || Status == NextCharterPlanStatus.Paused
            || Status == NextCharterPlanStatus.PendingCompletion;
=> Status == RepairWorkStatus.Working || Status == RepairWorkStatus.Paused || Status == RepairWorkStatus.AwaitingCheck;

=> OrdinaryMagic != null ? OrdinaryMagicSchema
            : Consecration != null ? ConsecrationSchema
            : FerryWraith != null ? FerryWraithSchema
            : DeclaredGeometry != null ? DeclaredGeometrySchema
            : BishopEntry != null ? BishopEntrySchema
            : PostRecoveryEncounter != null ? PostRecoveryEncounterSchema
            : ConnectedClericLongRest ? ConnectedClericLongRestSchema
            : ConnectedClericCasting ? ConnectedClericCastingSchema
            : ConnectedClericSettlement ? ConnectedClericSettlementSchema
            : ConnectedFrightened ? ConnectedFrightenedSchema
            : ConnectedClericRepertoire ? ConnectedClericRepertoireSchema
            : ConnectedClericRp ? ConnectedClericRpSchema
            : ConnectedFleshWarden ? ConnectedFleshWardenSchema
            : ConnectedShortRest ? ConnectedShortRestSchema
            : ConnectedConsumeDecay ? ConnectedConsumeDecaySchema
            : ConnectedWoundTreatment ? ConnectedWoundTreatmentSchema
            : ConnectedCompanionStabilization ? ConnectedCompanionStabilizationSchema
            : ConnectedCompanionDose ? ConnectedCompanionDoseSchema
            : ConnectedTacticalVial ? ConnectedTacticalVialSchema
            : ConnectedStowedVial ? ConnectedStowedVialSchema
            : ConnectedCarriedVial ? ConnectedCarriedVialSchema
            : ConnectedBatch != null ? ConnectedRecipe4BatchSchema
            : BloodSpecimen != null ? ConnectedBloodSpecimenSchema : ExplorationHide != null
            ? ConnectedExplorationObservation.IsSelected(this) ? ConnectedExplorationObservationSchema : ExplorationHideSchema
            : ExplorationSearch != null ? ExplorationSearchSchema : SchemaVersion;

=> ((int)Kind).ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
            + "|" + Actor + "|" + Target + "|" + ExpectedRevision.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
            + "|" + X.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
            + "|" + Y.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
            + (Inventory == null ? "" : "|inventory-v1|" + Inventory.Fingerprint)
            + (Combat == null ? "" : "|" + Combat.FingerprintVersion + "|" + Combat.Fingerprint)
            + (Advancement == null ? "" : Advancement.UsesClericSettlementReceipt
                ? "|character-level-v4|" + string.Join(",",Advancement.FeatureIds) + "|" + Advancement.InvocationPath + "|" + Advancement.EarnedSpell
                : Advancement.UsesLegacyPairReceipt
                ? "|character-level-v1|" + Advancement.FeatureOne + "|" + Advancement.FeatureTwo
                : Advancement.AsiAbilityIncreases.Count != 0 || Advancement.FeatId != ""
                    ? "|character-level-v3|" + string.Join(",",Advancement.FeatureIds) + "|"
                        + string.Join(",",Advancement.AsiAbilityIncreases.Select(x=>((int)x).ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)))
                        + "|" + Advancement.FeatId
                    : "|character-level-v2|" + string.Join(",",Advancement.FeatureIds))
            + (Ranged == null ? "" : "|ranged-v1|" + Ranged.Fingerprint)
            + (OverwatchRider == OverwatchRider.None ? "" : "|overwatch-rider-v1|" + ((int)OverwatchRider).ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))
            + (SuppressionFire == null ? "" : "|suppression-fire-v1|" + SuppressionFire.Fingerprint)
            + (DefensiveFormation == null ? "" : "|defensive-formation-v1|" + DefensiveFormation.Fingerprint)
            + (ExpeditionAssignment == null ? "" : ExpeditionAssignment.MiningSelection == null
                ? "|expedition-assignment-v1|" + ExpeditionAssignment.Fingerprint
                : "|expedition-mining-assignment-v1|" + ExpeditionAssignment.Fingerprint + "|" + ExpeditionAssignment.MiningSelection.Fingerprint)
            + (HarvestSelection == null ? "" : "|harvest-selection-v1|" + HarvestSelection.Fingerprint)
            + (MiningSelection == null ? "" : "|" + MiningSelection.FingerprintVersion + "|" + MiningSelection.Fingerprint)
            + (ProspectingExposure == null ? "" : "|prospecting-exposure-v1|" + ProspectingExposure.Fingerprint)
            + (RouteMappingWork == null ? "" : "|route-map-team-v1|" + RouteMappingWork.Fingerprint)
            + (IntimidatingPresence == null ? "" : "|intimidating-presence-v1|" + IntimidatingPresence.Fingerprint)
            + (consecrateRequest == null ? "" : "|consecrate-v1|" + consecrateRequest.Fingerprint)
            + (DivineInvocation == null ? "" : "|divine-invocation-v1|" + DivineInvocation.Fingerprint)
            + (HealingRite == null ? "" : "|healing-rite-v1|" + ((int)HealingRite.CurePreference).ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))
            + (SpellCast == null ? "" : "|spell-cast-v1|" + SpellCast.Fingerprint)
            + (SanctuaryResponse == null ? "" : "|sanctuary-response-v1|" + SanctuaryResponse.Fingerprint)
            + (Guidance == null ? "" : "|guidance-v1|" + Guidance.EffectId);
=>Amount.Denominator==1?Amount.Numerator:throw new InvalidOperationException("Fractional amount requires the exact quantity API.");
=>Amount.Denominator==1?Amount.Numerator:throw new InvalidOperationException("Fractional reservation requires the exact quantity API.");

snapshotDirectReferenceCensus.limits: Mentions include guards and may be gated off for selected wire; this is not serialized-value or semantic coverage proof.

disposition: No additional source blocker to the bounded private writer extraction was found. CT-08/09 and the nonserialized private passage must be explicit trusted-state limitations in the full contract; instrumented complete-read purity and historical-byte preservation remain required before implementation acceptance.
